mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 8.5% over a one-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, increasing recession risk and prompting a flight to safety that depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 8.5%, or the signal fails to generate negative returns in 70% of triggered cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts and retail sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and triggering negative forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 90.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real economic output, increasing the likelihood of a recession and causing negative forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases where INDPRO falls below 90.0, or the signal's predictive power is not significant (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the CPIAUCSL above 225.0 in a single month signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to delay rate cuts or initiate tightening, which increases equity discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 225.0, or the signal fails to generate negative returns in 70% of triggered cases.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in both housing starts and retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand and confidence, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate model.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in non-farm payrolls below 130,000 in a single month signals labor market weakness, increasing recession risk and causing negative forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS falls below 130,000, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized over the past six months signals a weakening economy, reducing corporate profitability and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth is below 1.0%, or the signal fails to generate negative returns in 70% of cases.
